strings.tl: Your 'Chart of Time' only remembers as far as the 'First Temple' or so, right? // [1]That's way too slow. Just findin' the way into 'Purgatory' would take half a year, even at best. // Folks'd just end up wonderin' if you really mean to look.
This ain't the time to go crawlin' around down there. We got that stupid-huge, hellishly hot Purgatory // to comb through inch by inch with what few hands we got.
So get back to your quarters, quick. // Don't worry, no rookies got hurt. Ain't none of your friends holds a grudge against you, probably.
Hey, hey, I told you to come with your friends, didn't I?
